_comment: Single source of truth for engine-neutral (common/ontology) technology parameters and their per-engine mappings. Consumed by BOTH the JS editor (src/services/parameterOntology.js) and the Python translators. Do NOT duplicate this mapping logic in either consumer. Common values are stored in canonical (Calliope) units; each common param maps to exactly one Calliope constraint or cost, so existing models reverse-map with no data loss. The `engines` blocks are the informational/target mapping the UI shows and the translators may use; where a mapping is an approximation or handled indirectly by a translator it carries a `note`.

capacity_max.label: Maximum installed capacity
capacity_max.description: Upper limit on installed power capacity of the technology.

osemosys.name: InputActivityRatio
osemosys.note: Encoded via input/output activity ratios, not a single field.

lifetime.label: Lifetime
lifetime.description: Economic lifetime of the technology, in years.

pypsa.name: capital_cost
pypsa.note: Feeds the annuity used for capital_cost; no standalone field.

ramp_rate.label: Ramp rate
ramp_rate.description: Maximum change in output per hour, as a fraction of capacity.

capex.label: Capital cost (per capacity)
capex.description: One-time investment cost per unit of power capacity.

opex_fixed.label: Fixed O&M cost
opex_fixed.description: Annual fixed operations & maintenance cost per unit of capacity.

opex_variable.label: Variable O&M cost
opex_variable.description: Operations & maintenance cost per unit of energy produced.

interest_rate.label: Interest rate
interest_rate.description: Discount / interest rate used to annualise investment costs.

storage_capacity_max.label: Maximum storage capacity
storage_capacity_max.description: Upper limit on stored energy capacity.

storage_capex.label: Storage capital cost (per energy)
storage_capex.description: Investment cost per unit of stored energy capacity.

storage_loss.label: Storage standing loss
storage_loss.description: Fraction of stored energy lost per hour.

c_rate.label: C-rate (power/energy)
c_rate.description: Ratio of power capacity to storage energy capacity.
